<thought>Chlorine shows a characteristic M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak, matching the natural 35Cl/37Cl isotopic ratio. The noticeable M+1 peak (~10 % of the base) is consistent with the cumulative contribution of ^13C isotopes, indicating the presence of carbon. No other element’s isotopic pattern (e.g., Br, S) matches the observed intensities. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are chlorine and carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl', 'C']</final_answer>
